categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of display driver chips. Its product portfolio includes integrated display chips, discrete display driver chips, and display power management chips, serving various terminal applications such as smart wearables, smartphones, industrial control displays, tablets, laptops, TVs, and automotive displays. The company operates under a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to specialized foundries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technologies including image compression, charge recovery low power technology, reduced photomask layers architecture, built-in capacitor technology, image enhancement, and AMOLED intelligent dynamic compensation. It employs a fabless production method, focusing on chip design and R&D while outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to partners like TSMC, Silterra, and others. The company emphasizes low power consumption, high integration, high resolution, and cost-effective chip designs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major display panel manufacturers such as BOE and Deep Tianma, as well as display module manufacturers like Yiqing Group and Yihua Display. The end markets served encompass consumer electronics (smart wearables, smartphones, tablets), industrial control displays, IT displays (laptops, monitors), TVs, commercial displays, and automotive displays. The company’s products support mainstream TFT-LCD and AMOLED technologies across various screen sizes and resolutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with headquarters and main operations in Shanghai. It has subsidiaries in Beijing, Xi'an, Hefei, and Hong Kong, covering domestic and some international markets. The Hong Kong subsidiary conducts R&D and sales activities, with transactions denominated in USD. The company’s customer base and supply chain are mainly concentrated in China, with strategic partnerships extending to Taiwan and Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics is positioned in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design company. It focuses on chip design and development, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to foundries and subcontractors. The company manages supply chain relationships with upstream wafer foundries and downstream panel and module manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on advanced display driver chip technologies to support high resolution, high refresh rates, low power consumption, and high integration. It is developing new products such as full HD LTPS RAMless integrated display driver chips, 8-bit discrete source driver chips, low power FHD notebook timing controller chips, AMOLED driver chips, electronic paper display drivers, and Mini/Micro-LED chips. Strategic collaborations with universities and industry partners enhance innovation and technology transfer.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuits, including display driver chips and power management chips. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by distributors, selling mainly to panel manufacturers and module assemblers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance, with some customized product sales and technology development services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic display chip supplier in China, competing with established players from Taiwan and South Korea. It holds a strong position in the Chinese market with a comprehensive product line covering various display technologies and applications. The company emphasizes technological innovation and supply chain collaboration to maintain competitive advantages and expand market share amid intensifying industry competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 480.4 million, representing a 12.52% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 27.5 million, a significant decline of 74.56% compared to the previous year, mainly due to macroeconomic and semiconductor cycle downturns. Total assets grew to RMB 1.8 billion, up 142.7%, and shareholders’ equity increased by 145.97% to RMB 1.6 billion, reflecting capital increases and business expansion. The company maintains a robust R&D investment ratio of about 11.87% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies that enable low power consumption, small chip area, high reliability, and cost-effective manufacturing. Its products support a wide range of display technologies and resolutions, including TFT-LCD and AMOLED, with strong anti-ESD capabilities and thermal performance. The company offers comprehensive display chip solutions tailored to diverse applications, emphasizing innovation, quality, and supply chain integration to meet evolving customer demands and promote domestic substitution of imported display chips.
